pairs: Listen to the word of the Lord,
quia judicium Domino cum habitatoribus terræ:
for the Lord is judge of the inhabitants of the land.
et non est scientia Dei in terra.
and there is no knowledge of God, in the land.
and bloodshed has brought more bloodshed.
et infirmabitur omnis qui habitat in ea,
and all who dwell in it will languish,
with the beasts of the field and the birds of the air.
And the fishes of the sea also will be gathered together.
So, truly, let each and every one not judge,
and let no man be accused,
populus enim tuus sicut hi qui contradicunt sacerdoti.
for your people are just like those who speak against the priesthood.
Et corrues hodie, et corruet etiam propheta tecum.
And you will be ruined on this day, and now the prophet will be ruined with you.
In the night, I have made your mother to be silent.
Conticuit populus meus, eo quod non habuerit scientiam:
My people have become silent because they had no knowledge.
quia tu scientiam repulisti, repellam te,
Since you have rejected knowledge, I will drive you away;
you do not perform the duties of the priesthood for me,
et oblita es legis Dei tui, obliviscar filiorum tuorum et ego.
and you have forgotten the law of your God, and so I will forget your sons.
Secundum multitudinem eorum sic peccaverunt mihi:
According to the multitude of them, so have they sinned against me.
I will change their glory into disgrace.
They will devour the sins of my people,
et ad iniquitatem eorum sublevabunt animas eorum.
and they will lift up their souls towards their iniquity.
And, just as it is with the people,
sic sacerdos; et visitabo super eum vias ejus,
so will it be with the priest; and I will visit their ways upon them,
and I will repay them for their intentions.
And they will eat and not be satisfied.
Since they have abandoned the Lord,
quoniam Dominum dereliquerunt in non custodiendo.
Populus meus in ligno suo interrogavit,
My people have inquired of their stave,
and their staff has announced to them.
For the spirit of fornication has deceived them,
et fornicati sunt a Deo suo.
and they have been fornicating before their God.
Super capita montium sacrificabant, et super colles ascendebant thymiama;
They have offered sacrifice on the tops of the mountains and burnt incense on the hills,
ideo fornicabuntur filiæ vestræ, et sponsæ vestræ adulteræ erunt.
therefore, your daughters will commit fornication and your spouses will be adulteresses.
Non visitabo super filias vestras cum fuerint fornicatæ,
I will not send afflictions on your daughters, when they will commit fornication,
et super sponsas vestras cum adulteraverint,
nor on your spouses, when they will commit adultery,
quoniam ipsi cum meretricibus conversabantur, et cum effeminatis sacrificabant;
because you yourselves have associated with harlots and have offered sacrifice with the effeminate,
and because the people who do not understand will be defeated.
at least let Judah not commit offenses;
and do not be willing to enter into Gilgal,
Quoniam sicut vacca lasciviens declinavit Israël;
For Israel has gone astray like a wanton heifer;
nunc pascet eos Dominus, quasi agnum in latitudine.
so now the Lord will pasture them like a young lamb in a wide expanse.
Their feasting has been set aside;
they have committed fornication after fornication.
They love to bring disgrace to their protectors.
Ligavit eum spiritus in alis suis,
The wind has fastened them to its wings,
and they will be confounded because of their sacrifices.
